description: Use for the average ZUS pension paid now, disability and survivor pensions, sickness allowances, and the dates when ZUS pays pensions (payment calendar, holidays, 800+). For a future pension, use get_pension_forecast. Average old-age pension paid by ZUS (gross and net), disability and survivor pensions, number of pensioners, sickness and maternity allowances, the pension to wage ratio finwire_pension_wage_ratio, CPI, minimum pension and indexations, monthly from preliminary ZUS data (without KRUS and uniformed services). Also the ZUS payment calendar: the next payment for each payment day, with dates moved before weekends and public holidays, 800+ payment deadlines, the social pension (renta socjalna) and the conditions of the ZUS top-up to the minimum pension (art. 87: age 60/65, 20/25 years of service).

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

payment_day.description: Day of the month in the ZUS pension decision, e.g. 10; returns the payment dates for this day in the next 12 months.

name: get_pension_stats
title: Average ZUS pension and benefits
